headline_hook: Claude Takes the Wheel as NVIDIA Drops Kimodo and GLM-5.1 Claims the Open-Source Crown
preview_topics: the case against over-engineered CLAUDE.md files

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Computer use isn't just a feature — it's Anthropic's bet that the next agent interface isn't chat but full desktop control, and the gap between 'AI assistant' and 'AI operator' just collapsed to a research preview toggle.

model_literacy.relevance: Claude's computer use relies on vision-based screen understanding rather than OS-level accessibility APIs — today's launch makes it worth understanding how screenshot-to-action loops work, their latency tradeoffs, and why this approach generalizes across any app without integration work.
